name: Brenner
bio: Saltmarrow's oldest fisherman, forty-one years on the cod grounds. Sits on a fish box at the end of the breakwater watching the Greying bank off the harbor mouth. Rowed through it once and came home not knowing what his catch was for; dropped his pipe in the harbor when the Gull caught. Kept the tally of Dunstan's springtime dare to the Low Water's edge.
